services.name: Remote Supplier Check
services.description: Company registration, manufacturer-vs-trader status, address and payment-account consistency.
services.delivery: Written report within 48 hours of receiving payment and the supplier details; in English or Spanish as the client prefers.
services.notes: Credited toward an on-site verification if the client continues.

services.name: Live Video Factory Verification
services.minimum: 1 hour; time beyond the first hour is billed in half-hour steps
services.description: A SourciaVera team member walks the factory on live HD video while the client directs the call, in English or Spanish; the client can ask to see specific machines, warehouse areas and documents.
services.delivery: Booked in advance; the recording of the call is sent afterward. No written report (for a written report, choose the on-site Factory Verification).
services.notes: Guangzhou and surrounding area included; other regions quoted separately for travel. Not part of the 20% consultation discount.

services.name: Factory Verification (on-site visit)
services.description: In-person visit: business license, production line and the product checked against specification, filmed and delivered as unedited video.
services.delivery: Report within 48 hours of the visit.
services.discount: 20% discount after a detailed consultation (applies to the three on-site services)

services.name: Pre-Shipment Inspection
services.description: Third-party inspection before the goods leave China, with unedited video.
services.discount: 20% discount after a detailed consultation (applies to the three on-site services)

services.name: Factory Audit
services.discount: 20% discount after a detailed consultation (applies to the three on-site services)

services.name: China Sourcing Agent
services.description: Factory search, negotiation, purchase, inspection on video and delivery coordination.
services.notes: Charged only when the purchase closes.

services.name: Small-batch orders
services.description: Stock items from 1 piece; custom and private-label orders from 50 pieces. Quote on request via WhatsApp.

payment_note: Fixed prices whatever the result of the check; the company takes no commission from factories.
